name: dp92987-claude-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code plugins by dp92987.

plugins.name: learning-loop
plugins.description: Self-learning loop for personal engineering style

plugins.name: codex-tandem
plugins.description: Claude orchestrates, Codex codes: default routing of implementation work to Codex CLI with independent review

plugins.name: jira-ticket-creator
plugins.description: Create a Jira ticket: fills the fields you would fill by hand, leaves status and assignee alone, description shaped by issue type; team specifics live in a profile picked by the repo's git remote

plugins.name: session-report-for-jira
plugins.description: Post a session report (accomplishments + honest /usage cost and token metadata) as a Jira comment

plugins.name: style-guard
plugins.description: Personal Go style enforcement in three tiers: ast-grep on every edit, golangci-lint over the diff as a finish gate, and taste rules checked by a fan-out review pass gated on PR creation

plugins.name: worktree-janitor
plugins.description: Inventory and clean up git worktrees: per-tree proof of whether its work can be lost — uncommitted, unpushed, or already merged including squash-merges — with deletion only on explicit request

plugins.name: github-pr-creator
plugins.description: Create a GitHub PR from the current branch: conventional title with the Jira key, body of ticket link + what was done + verified line + a mandatory rollout section (only services that must actually be rolled out, production clusters read from deploy manifests, order, config keys and secret names before/after); fills only title, body and base; follows the repo's PR template strictly when present
